DIAGNOSIS READY: Varicella (Chickenpox) secondary to vaccine failure or waning immunity.

The presence of multiple painless, nonpruritic papules in a child with recent exposure to chickenpox, despite up-to-date immunizations, is highly suggestive of varicella. The lack of itching and pain is atypical but can occur in vaccinated breakthrough cases or if the lesions are in early stages.
